About Us

Zetta Farms connects the world of agriculture with you, with ease. We bring together farm expertise and business intelligence.

Zetta Farms add value to the agriculture sector by being the center of the agriculture economy connecting farmers, landowners, agtech startups, farm supplement providers and farm equipment providers.

  • Achievements
  • Goals

We have been growing rapidly.

  • Recipient of ‘National Agripreneur’s Award – 2017’ by EAI powered by Holland
  • ~20000 Acres under cultivation
  • ~3400 Tonnes produced till date

We have been growing rapidly.

  • Recipient of ‘National Agripreneur’s Award – 2017’ by EAI powered by Holland
  • ~20000 Acres under cultivation
  • ~3400 Tonnes produced till date

Our Process

We believe in processes which enable the best of outcome for all the efforts.

Farm Project

Sustainable farm projects with latest infrastructure.

Production

Superior crop production with 30% higher yield.

Grading & Sorting

The harvest is graded and sorted after washing to get better pricing accordingly.

Packing

Hygienic packing process before transport

Market

Fetching better returns through our market linkages.

Our Zetta Farmers

Meet the face of modern farmers who want to transform the agriculture ecosystem. Let’s put names to these faces:

Rituraj Sharma

Director
